releases.name: v0.5.0 — TUI + Desktop
releases.body:
# v0.5.0

OpenCode Peak Badge now works in **OpenCode Desktop** as well as the TUI.

## Highlights

- **Desktop GUI support** — a compact `[PEAK]` / `[OFF-PEAK]` chip in the session header, next to the context indicator, plus a status strip on Home.
- **Shared peak logic** — TUI and Desktop use the same model rules, UTC windows and running-subagent aggregation.
- **Stable plugin identity** — an identity-only server part gives both clients the `peak-badge` id.
- **Config fixes** — explicitly empty `models` and `windows` arrays are now respected instead of falling back to the defaults.
- **Evaluation helpers** — `fakeTime` and `OPENCODE_PEAK_HOURS_FAKE_TIME` remain available for testing.

## Requirements

> **Minimum version:** OpenCode **2.4.2**. Users on older V2 builds should stay on `0.4.x`.

- TUI and Desktop require OpenCode 2.4.2 or newer.
- The Desktop GUI plugin API is experimental.

## Install

```sh
opencode plugin add opencode-peak-badge
```

Desktop reads `opencode.json(c)`; `cli.json` is TUI-only.

## Notes

- The package ships prebuilt bundles only: `dist/tui.js`, `dist/server.js` and `dist/gui-experimental.cjs`.
- No runtime dependencies.
- The exact position of the header chip relative to native header actions is controlled by OpenCode.
- Full changelog: https://github.com/hugobatista/opencode-peak-badge/compare/v0.4.0...v0.5.0
